changes.summary: Retained-power window after ignition off is extended from 45 s to 60 s (front-door exit still ends it). WLC-023 (also 60 s) is deleted as a duplicate; the old 45 s vs 60 s conflict is resolved in favour of 60 s.

Close trigger changes from the rain sensor to the CAN request WLC_CloseAll. The close must run in express mode with anti-pinch protection active. The rain trigger is removed and an anti-pinch claim is added.
Pinch detection threshold drops from 100 N to 80 N. Detection is more sensitive, so false-reversal risk rises (LL-2021 applies).
Pinch reversal distance rises from at least 125 mm to at least 150 mm, still capped by fully open.
'set itself to not normalized' becomes 'set its state to not normalized'. Same trigger (>500 ms supply interruption) and same result.

Vague 'reduce to a safe value' becomes a measurable rule: when the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, motor current is limited to 15 A. The limit relies on an estimate, so LL-2024-01 applies.
WLC_Status period changes from 100 ms ± 10 ms to 50 ms ± 5 ms. Frame rate doubles, so bus load and queue margins change (LL-2024-09).

WLC-030 now only requires storing B1A02 (motor current above 25 A for more than 50 ms). The stop-motor and set-fault-state reactions move to new WLC-037 and WLC-038. System behaviour is unchanged, but the requirement scope and traceability change.

tests.new_pass_criteria: No current limit can be set from the supplied text: the 100 µA limit came from deleted WLC-032. Pass only against a sleep-current limit stated in WLC-004 (text not supplied).
tests.reason: Remove the trace to deleted WLC-032 and keep WLC-004. The test cannot pass or fail on a limit until WLC-004 states one.

tests.new_pass_criteria: After ignition off: window moves on a switch press at 50 s; no movement on a press at 65 s; no movement after a front door is opened at 10 s.
tests.reason: The old 'no movement at 50 s' matched the old 45 s limit. Under the new 60 s limit, movement is required at 50 s, so the old criteria would fail the new requirement. Also remove the trace to deleted WLC-023.

tests.new_pass_criteria: With the window half open, after one WLC_CloseAll request from the body controller, the window closes fully in express mode with no further input, with anti-pinch protection active during the close (pinch stop and reversal verified per TC-AP-06).
tests.reason: The rain signal is no longer a trigger, so the procedure must send WLC_CloseAll and check express mode and anti-pinch. Rename the title, which still says 'Close on rain'.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Motor stops within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
tests.reason: The threshold changed from 100 N to 80 N and the reversal from 125 mm to 150 mm. The rod is at 100 mm, so the fully-open clause may govern the reversal. Its pass criteria must use the new numbers.

tests.new_pass_criteria: At 9.0 V: motor stops within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
tests.reason: Its pass criteria refer to 'As TC-AP-01', so it inherits the new limits. State them explicitly so the test does not depend on the reference.

tests.new_pass_criteria: At 16.0 V: motor stops within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
tests.reason: Same threshold and reversal change as TC-AP-01, reached by reference. State the limits explicitly.

tests.new_pass_criteria: At 9.0 V and -30 °C: motor stops within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
tests.reason: Cold and low voltage is the worst case for stop time (LL-2022), so run it first for this release. The limits changed, so state them explicitly.

tests.new_pass_criteria: At 13.5 V and 85 °C: motor stops within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
tests.reason: Same threshold and reversal change as TC-AP-01, reached by reference. State the limits explicitly.

tests.new_pass_criteria: No false pinch detection and no reversal during the rough-road vibration profile, with the 80 N threshold active.
tests.reason: Remove the trace to deleted WLC-018. Keep the test: LL-2021 requires a false-reversal check after any change to the force threshold, and this test is that check. Add traces to WLC-014 and WLC-015 and rerun at 80 N.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Unchanged: normalized after a 400 ms interruption; not normalized after 600 ms (500 ms threshold unchanged).
tests.reason: WLC-021 changed editorially only; the behaviour and the 500 ms limit are the same.

tests.new_pass_criteria: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, measured motor current does not exceed 15 A. The estimate is verified as current before the run (LL-2024-01).
tests.reason: The pass criterion 'motor current reduced' is replaced by the quantified 130 °C and 15 A limits. The procedure must use 130 °C instead of 'the limit'.

tests.new_pass_criteria: WLC_Status period 50 ms ± 5 ms over 10 s, measured under worst-case bus load including a diagnostic session; all four signals present (window position, movement state, normalization state, fault state).
tests.reason: The period changed from 100 ms ± 10 ms to 50 ms ± 5 ms. LL-2024-09 requires the worst bus load, including diagnostic sessions, and the test as written uses only a moving window.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Unchanged: B1A02 stored, motor stopped, fault state set in WLC_Status. Verify the fault bit on the bus.
tests.reason: Pass criteria remain valid. The stop and fault reactions moved to WLC-037 and WLC-038, so the test must be run again against the new split and extended to those traces.
Its only traced requirement, WLC-033 ('user friendly'), is deleted. The 4-of-5 rating has no source in any remaining requirement.

added.extend_test: Extend TC-AP-01 (pinch at nominal voltage) with a re-close step after the reversal.
added.pass_criteria: After a pinch reversal, an express close request sent within 2 s of the reversal (e.g. at 1.0 s and 1.9 s) does not start the motor. The same request sent after 2 s (e.g. at 2.5 s) starts the close.

added.extend_test: Extend TC-DG-02 (overcurrent) to check the motor stops after B1A02 is stored.
added.pass_criteria: After B1A02 is stored (27 A injected for 100 ms), the motor is stopped and no movement occurs. Record the storage-to-stop time, but no pass limit can be set until WLC-037 states a time.

added.extend_test: Extend TC-DG-02 to read the fault state from the WLC_Status frame on the bus. TC-CAN-01 can also check the fault bit.
added.pass_criteria: After B1A02 is stored, the fault state in WLC_Status is set, read from the CAN frame.

concerns.test: TC-AP-06 (WLC-016, not in the affected list)
concerns.concern: Pinch protection in manual and express mode uses the pinch threshold, which changed from 100 N to 80 N, and may hard-code the old limit. It also does not cover the new CAN-triggered express close (WLC-012), which claims anti-pinch protection with no test. Check its pass criteria and rerun it. Extend it or TC-MV-07 to cover a pinch during a WLC_CloseAll close.

concerns.test: WLC-012 vs WLC-017 / WLC-013 (TC-AP-07, TC-MV-08, not in the affected list)
concerns.concern: Possible requirement conflict. WLC-012 says the CAN-triggered express close is 'with anti-pinch protection active', but WLC-017 turns anti-pinch off when not normalized, and WLC-013 allows express close only when normalized. Clarify with the requirement owner whether the WLC_CloseAll close is gated by normalization, and rerun TC-AP-07 and TC-MV-08 once clarified.
The 2 s inhibit does not say whether it covers the CAN WLC_CloseAll request (WLC-012) as well as the switch express close. Clarify the scope before the extension is written.

The rod is placed at 100 mm. If it is near the top, the 'whichever is less' fully-open clause governs the reversal, so the test cannot demonstrate 150 mm. Confirm the rod geometry and record the travel to fully open.

concerns.test: TC-AP-08 (WLC-019, not in the affected list)
concerns.concern: A lower threshold (80 N) changes the count of pinch detections, which can change the repeated-pinch lockout behaviour. The lockout may also interact with the new 2 s inhibit (WLC-039). Rerun and confirm.
Cold plus low voltage is the worst case for stop time. Run TC-AP-04 at the start of this release, not at the end of the program.
Do not retire this test because WLC-018 was deleted. It is the only false-reversal check for the new 80 N threshold. Add traces to WLC-014 and WLC-015 so the link is explicit.

concerns.test: TC-TH-02, TC-TH-01 (WLC-024, not in the affected list)
concerns.concern: The new 130 °C limit uses an estimate, so LL-2024-01 applies. Check that the estimate is current and that the shared platform thermal module fix for WLC-200 is present before running these tests. TC-TH-01 (thermal model accuracy) should be rerun with TC-TH-02.

concerns.test: TC-TH-03, TC-TH-04 (WLC-026, WLC-027, not in the affected list)
concerns.concern: Confirm the new 130 °C current limit does not conflict with the opening-block and thermal-release thresholds in WLC-026 and WLC-027. Their criteria were not supplied, so this could not be checked.

Halving the cycle time from 100 ms to 50 ms doubles the WLC_Status frame rate. This is a required analysis, not a test: repeat the worst-case queue calculation including diagnostic sessions and check the WLC_CloseAll request path under load.

concerns.test: TC-DG-03 (WLC-031, not in the affected list)
concerns.concern: The diagnostic response time may need to bound the B1A02 stop and fault reactions now in WLC-037 and WLC-038. WLC-031 was not supplied, so check it. WLC-037 also has no time limit.

concerns.test: TC-DG-01 (WLC-029, not in the affected list) and LL-2023
concerns.concern: Not changed, but check the lesson: the Hall sensor test should remove the sensor while the actuator runs at the lowest supply voltage, with a timeout check. Separately, the rain sensor is no longer used by WLC-012. If the controller still reads it, it needs a plausibility check, a timeout and a removal test under LL-2023. If not, remove the input.
Deleting WLC-032 may leave a gap, not just cleanup. If WLC-004 does not state a sleep current limit, no current requirement remains. Confirm the intent with the requirement owner.
The old specification had a 45 s vs 60 s conflict for the same function. Check other documents, reports and user manuals for references to the old 45 s value.
Usability is no longer verified. If it is still a product need, write a measurable requirement first. The subjective 5-driver review should not be reinstated without one.
The software-process requirement is deleted and no test traces to it. Handle it through a process audit, not a test. Confirm that the process obligation is still tracked elsewhere.

WLC-018 ('robust against all disturbances') was not testable. Its intent is covered only by the measurable WLC-014 and WLC-015 requirements and by TC-AP-09. Confirm that no disturbance requirement is lost.

added.WLC-039: After a pinch reversal, express close shall be inhibited for 2 s.
added.WLC-037: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall stop the motor.
added.WLC-038: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.

deleted.WLC-018: The anti-pinch function shall be robust against all disturbances.
deleted.WLC-023: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s.
deleted.WLC-032: In sleep mode, the controller shall draw less than 100 µA from the 12 V supply.
deleted.WLC-033: The controller shall be user friendly.
deleted.WLC-034: The software shall be developed according to the company software process.

WLC-007.old: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 45 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.
WLC-007.new: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.

WLC-012.old: The window shall close quickly when the rain sensor reports rain.
WLC-012.new: When the body controller sends the CAN request WLC_CloseAll, the controller shall close the window in express mode, with anti-pinch protection active.

WLC-014.old: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 100 N.
WLC-014.new: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 80 N.

WLC-015.old: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 125 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
WLC-015.new: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.

WLC-021.old: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set itself to not normalized.
WLC-021.new: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set its state to not normalized.

WLC-025.old: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds the limit, the controller shall reduce motor current to a safe value.
WLC-025.new: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, the controller shall limit motor current to 15 A.

WLC-028.old: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 100 ms ± 10 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.
WLC-028.new: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 50 ms ± 5 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.

WLC-030.old: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms and shall stop the motor and shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.
WLC-030.new: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms.
